scope: all five NYC boroughs; all source land uses; no sample filter

sources.title: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)
BUILDING — Building Footprints
sources.publisher: NYC Office of Technology and Innovation

borough_assignment: PLUTO borocode for lots; leading BIN digit, falling back to source BBL digits, for footprint records
limitations: Coverage means all records in the two official source datasets at their recorded revisions, not a census of every physical structure in reality.
Building-footprint row count is not unique BIN count. Source includes garages, auxiliary structures, tanks and placeholder geometries; some BINs repeat or are unassigned.
Official footprint capture normally includes buildings larger than 400 square feet and taller than 12 feet, plus other buildings with agency BINs; documented exclusions remain excluded by the source.
BIN/BBL linkage prefers the official mappluto_bbl billing-lot join, then base_bbl if matched. No guessed or spatial nearest-lot matches are created.
PLUTO building area, floor count and use are tax-lot context and must not be presented as an individual footprint measurement.
Footprint area is calculated in EPSG:2263 US survey feet. Source shape_area/shape_length are retained for audit but are not used as measurements.
Footprint representative points are guaranteed internal to valid polygons and are not surveyed entrances. Invalid or missing geometries are counted explicitly.
HVI is a historical neighborhood vulnerability index joined through Census 2020 ZCTA, not a building heat or future temperature estimate.
Future membership is an approximate-point overlay with the historical NPCC2013 +31-inch 2050–2059 coastal scenario, outside scoring. It gives no depth or site-specific risk verdict.
Derived footprint area and spatial risk context are null for seven invalid geometries and 34 placeholder triangles. Source geometry and preview positions are retained for audit.
Rent, current vacancy, ceiling clearance, floor load, electrical capacity, legal use permission and loading-dock capacity remain unverified.
